subject: PO fields & invoice cadence constraints for CareBridge - billing onboarding
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@carebridge.io>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements for vendor onboarding / invoice cadence

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement at CareBridge has a few mandatory PO and invoicing requirements before we can activate a vendor in our AP system. Wanted to share them up front so we can avoid back-and-forth during onboarding:

- PO must include: CareBridge GL code, BU cost center, project ID, and a single-line vendor tax ID (EIN).
- We require a blanket PO (master PO) for platform SaaS services; the PO number needs to be referenced on every invoice.
- Invoice cadence: we prefer weekly invoices for cloud consumption items (AP team runs weekly settlements), but can accept monthly consolidated invoices if weekly is operationally incompatible.
- Net terms: CareBridge standard is net60, but procurement can accept net45 with an approved vendor credit review.
- Remittance: ACH to our bank (will share routing in the PO template).

Attached is our PO template for your vendor team (CareBridge_PO_Template.docx). Can you confirm Redwood can populate the required PO fields and whether you can support weekly invoice batches or would prefer monthly consolidated invoices? Also need any vendor setup forms we should expect.

Goal: get vendor activated and first invoice issued for pilot week of Sep 1.

Thanks,
Priya Desai
Head of Procurement, CareBridge
priya.desai@carebridge.io
CareBridge Health

Attachment: CareBridge_PO_Template.docx (DOCX)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@carebridge.io>, CareBridge AP <ap@carebridge.io>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements for vendor onboarding / invoice cadence

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the PDF and clear checklist. Short answers up front: we can populate the fields you listed, and we support both weekly stub reports and monthly consolidated invoices — we typically default to monthly consolidated invoices for hosted API customers, but we can do a weekly lane for early usage if it stays under a defined threshold.

A few specifics from our side:
- PO fields: we can accept GL, cost center, project ID as line-level or header-level metadata. Please indicate whether you want those mapped to invoice line items or to a header metadata block.
- Invoice cadence options: 
  * Weekly: feasible if weekly invoice volume is expected to be <= $50k/week (AP operational constraint). Weekly invoicing carries a small processing surcharge.
  * Monthly consolidated: default option with no surcharge; includes a weekly activity report on request.
- Net terms: standard Redwood commercial is net45. Net60 is possible but requires a credit review and either a 12-month commitment or prepay/credit arrangement.
- Remittance and vendor setup: attaching our billing guidelines and remittance instructions so your AP team has the standard fields we export.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You upload the filled PO template (or provide the DocuSign blanket PO) so we can validate field mapping.
2) Confirm whether CareBridge will sign a 12-month commitment (or accept net45 + monthly invoices).
3) If weekly invoices are required, indicate expected weekly spend so we can route to our billing lane owner.

Attaching: redwood-billing-guidelines.pdf, remittance-instructions.pdf.

I can loop in finance and billing ops internally to confirm the net-term flow if you need a formal exception.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-billing-guidelines.pdf (PDF), remittance-instructions.pdf (PDF)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: PO requirements for vendor onboarding / invoice cadence — CareBridge (need finance + billing ops input)

Vivek / Grace —

Forwarding CareBridge's procurement note. Key asks: net60, blanket PO w/ GL/cost center/project ID, and a preference for weekly invoices. They said weekly is preferred but can accept monthly if weekly is operationally incompatible. Pilot kickoff target is week of Sep 1.

My read: we can populate the fields and support a weekly lane for low-volume pilots, but net60 is outside standard terms. Can we do conditional net60 if they sign 12-month commitment or provide a prepay/credit? If not, can we offer monthly invoicing + weekly activity stub as a compromise? Also need to confirm whether the $50k/week threshold is a hard limit from billing ops.

Can you weigh in so I can reply with an approved option?

Thanks,
Naomi

--- Forwarded message attached above ---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: PO requirements for vendor onboarding / invoice cadence — CareBridge (need finance + billing ops input)

Thanks Naomi — quick guidance from finance:

- Net terms: Finance prefers to keep net45 as standard. We can make an exception to net60 *only* if CareBridge signs a minimum 12-month commitment (we'd tie to deal_id CB-2026-0487) or provides a 25% prepayment/credit against the first two months.
- Weekly invoicing: operationally OK for pilots, but we need the expected weekly spend to be <= $50k/week; otherwise it creates an extra processing burden. If weekly is required and spend > $50k/week, billing ops will insist on a monthly consolidated invoice and weekly breakdown report.
- PO fields: we can map all fields (GL, cost center, project ID) to our invoice metadata. We prefer header-level mapping where possible for easier ERP reconciliation.

If CareBridge accepts the 12-month commit or prepay, finance will approve net60 and we'll flag the account for monthly credit monitoring. Otherwise offer net45 + monthly consolidated invoice + weekly activity stub.

-Vivek
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Larkin <tom.larkin@carebridge.io>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, priya.desai@carebridge.io
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements for vendor onboarding / invoice cadence

Naomi / Priya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for laying out options. CareBridge can sign a 12-month SOW tied to the platform subscription (we're comfortable with a 12-month commitment for the pilot->production path). We'll complete the blanket PO and include the GL/cost center/project ID header metadata as requested.

We prefer monthly consolidated invoices for treasury efficiency, but we do need weekly usage stubs (CSV) delivered every Monday to our AP inbox so our weekly reconciliation still works. We understand the net45 vs net60 constraints and will accept net60 since we're signing the 12-month commitment.

I've attached the signed DocuSign PO and included a link to the DocuSign record: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/AAA-12345-CB. Please confirm next steps for vendor setup and expected date of first invoice. Our pilot consumption window starts Sep 1 — ideally first invoice (stub) week of Sep 7 and consolidated invoice on Sep 30.

Tom Larkin
Director, Vendor Programs — CareBridge Health
Tom.Larkin@carebridge.io

Attachment: docusign-purchase-order.pdf (PDF)
